scope: One actual local tool-routing/execution step and one grounded follow-up answer per model. The tool uses the same structured research shape as MCP, not a remote MCP network round trip. Reported times include model/Gateway latency but exclude production browser and MCP transport. One sample per task cannot establish general model quality, p95 latency or a durable pricing advantage.
cost_note: Catalog-based estimate uses total input/output counts, including reported reasoning output. No cache discount or provider-specific billing correction is assumed. Gateway-reported cost is preserved where present.

recommendation.reason: Both models completed the scoped tool call and preserved all numeric/release/source facts. In this two-step microbenchmark, GPT-5 nano used more total tokens and was slower and more expensive despite its lower input-token list price. No production routing change is justified by this sample.
recommendation.generalization_limit: One sample for each phase; not a broad benchmark, p95 estimate or permanent provider ranking.

grading_note: Numeric interval grading accepts equivalent decimal [0.4,0.8] and percentage 40%-80% forms. Both returned answers were manually inspected for the same facts; no extra model requests were made for regrading.
